capacity.threshold_crossing_use: named remediation, integration, observation and question-bank practice within allowance; no feature expansion
capacity.reserve: 20% of post-Day-171 engineering hours already inside daily budget

detailed_inserted_units.task: Inventory the selected policy API consumer and producer routes
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Record exact request, success, error, auth and ownership behavior from LocalPolicyIssueController; pin independent fixture.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Author OpenAPI operations and request/response schemas
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Represent GET /api/policies/{policyId} and POST /api/policies with 200/201/400/401/404 outcomes; validate paths, methods, required fields and status schema.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Check the contract against runtime Spring mappings
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Compare method/path set and required request/response fields against actual controller mappings; fail on missing or extra public operation.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Run consumer compatibility against an additive provider revision
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Independent expected consumer accepts optional response additions and unchanged required fields; reject removed/renamed required field and changed status.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Add mutation controls and publish compatibility evidence
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Mutate canonical spec to break method/path/required field/status and ensure actual oracle rejects; capture command, diff and exact errors.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Add the isolated OIDC learner seam and offline issuer fixture
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Keep existing cookie-session profile intact; define test-only issuer metadata, JWKS and synthetic tenant mapping; no live keys.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Configure actual Spring Security JWT resource-server path
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Validate issuer, signature, audience and standard temporal claims using framework decoder; protected route defaults deny.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Exercise discovery and signed JWKS token through HTTP
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Use local disposable issuer serving OIDC discovery/JWKS and signed synthetic tokens; assert actual filter chain returns expected response.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Test wrong issuer, audience and expired token denials
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Each must produce 401 with no protected body and no handler invocation; independent signed variants.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Test missing signature, malformed token and unknown key
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Each denies closed; no bypassing decoder or mock Authentication in protocol path.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Rotate local signing key and verify overlap behavior
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Publish keyset with old+new kid, then new-only; verify cached/refresh behavior and retired-key denial.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Enforce tenant claim against requested tenant boundary
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Valid same-tenant succeeds; foreign, missing and malformed tenant claim deny with no content disclosure.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Check scope/audience and permission matrix
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Assert least-privilege scope grants only assigned read; write/unknown scope is denied and error body is sanitized.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Run full positive and negative protocol acceptance
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: One real local discovery→JWKS→Spring JWT verification flow plus all denial controls; record exact selectors and evidence.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Pin baseline schema and old/new reader contract
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Use disposable PostgreSQL and existing Flyway V005 baseline; enumerate exact rows and readers/writers before additive migration.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Expand schema additively with nullable/versioned field
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Flyway migration must leave old reader/writer operational and exact preexisting rows unchanged.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Implement bounded deterministic backfill batches
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Idempotent cursor/checkpoint over stable primary key; expected IDs/count/hash are independently fixed in fixture.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Interrupt between batches and restart from checkpoint
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Kill/restart process; prove no skipped/duplicate updates and exact final values; malformed cursor fails closed.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Exercise old and new application compatibility
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Run old code against expanded schema and new code against expanded data; assert exact values and no destructive change.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Prove forward recovery after deliberately bad candidate
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Reject unsafe contract migration; restore via forward migration and reconcile exact row set/checksum.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Verify contract/cleanup eligibility and publish evidence
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Contract only in isolated disposable DB after old readers retired; assert row equivalence, migrations and exact evidence; no live database.

GAP-AIGOV: Synthetic data inventory and minimized-field map with source-to-index-to-eval retention lineage.
Deletion evidence across source/cache/index/evaluation artifacts with independent expected counts and no silent residue.
Independent relevant slices for tenant/access/deletion/uncertainty; report denominators, uncertainty and limitations.
Provider data boundary and authorization decision; no provider calls absent separate authorization.
GAP-IAC: One selected IaC tool and version, local fixture/module with no credentials or cloud apply.
Offline validate/plan plus independent expected plan summary and drift mutation rejection.
Recreate/rollback/cleanup rehearsal with exact resource inventory and no real cloud state.
Actual deployment remains blocked pending separately authorized spend, credentials, account and security review.
GAP-ENTERPRISE: Named simulated security, privacy, procurement, service and operations decision owners and required evidence.
A missing/denied approval blocks release; test allowed, denied and deferred launch outcomes.
Real customer/workplace data, production deployment and enterprise approval remain external gates.
Simulations never count as external approval, live operations or customer outcome.

first_21_units.acceptance_approach: independent expected fixtures, actual Spring Security/SQL execution paths, positive controls, negative controls and implementation mutation tests
